notes.title: Umbra: Journey Home NextFest Livestream
notes.content:
As part of Steam's NextFest I'll be playing Umbra. 

I get a lot of questions like:

What was your inspiration?
How long did it take to make?
and
How does babby form?

Well if you wanted to ask the first two questions or have others then now's your time. 

I'll be livestreaming the demo, talking to chat and giving insights into the creation. 

If you're interested or just want to swing by and say hello.

Thanks

-Thomas
